cluster_inventory.description: 产前脾脏中鉴定的B1细胞，高表达MS4A1(CD20)、CD27、SPN(CD43)，经FACS分选与ELISpot实验证实具有自主自发分泌IgM功能
位于产前外周器官(脾脏、胸腺)中靠近CDH5+血管的外周B细胞前体，经4重smFISH原位杂交证实共表达VPREB1、RAG1、DNTT
位于外周器官的原位造血祖细胞，经smFISH原位杂交证实共表达KLF1与TESPA1
位于产前小肠与胸腺的外周髓系祖细胞，经smFISH原位杂交证实共表达MPO与AZU1

cluster_inventory.organ_or_tissue: pan-fetal organs (liver, spleen, skin, lung, etc.)
cluster_inventory.description: 分布于多器官间质与血管周的胎儿巨噬细胞亚群，特征性高表达LYVE1与F13A1
富集于胎儿红系造血与清除器官的铁回收巨噬细胞，特征性高表达SLC40A1与TIMD4

cluster_inventory.organ_or_tissue: fetal central nervous system and peripheral neurovascular niches
cluster_inventory.description: 神经系统及神经相关微环境中的小胶质样巨噬细胞，高表达TREM2与P2RY12
骨重塑破骨细胞，高表达基质金属蛋白酶MMP9与ACP5(TRAP)

coverage_summary.materials_reviewed_scope: Reviewed 72-page Supplementary Materials PDF including detailed experimental methods and Supplementary Figures S1 to S33 with smFISH and ELISpot functional validations.
coverage_summary.missing_materials: Main text PDF formatting not merged locally; Supplementary Tables S1-S18 standalone Excel files not provided.
coverage_summary.potential_leakage_scope: Individual genes in extensive multi-organ differential expression lists (Supplementary Tables S1-S18) beyond the experimentally validated and figured markers.
